fullContentHtml:
NTA SWAYAM July Online Form 2026 – Full Details

National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the notification for the Study Webs of Active Learning for Young Aspiring Minds SWAYAM 2026 (July 2026 Semester) Examination on the official website of the NTA recently. The online application process for NTA SWAYAM Online Form 2026 has started on 09 October 2026, and candidates can apply till 31 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for NTA SWAYAM Online Form 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 09 October 2026
  • Last Date : 31 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 01 November 2026
  • Correction Date : 02-03 November 2026
  • Exam Date : 08, 09, 10, 11 & 12 December 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General : Rs. 750/- (Add Course 600/-)
  • OBC NCL, EWS : Rs. 500/- (Add Course 400/-)
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 500/- (Add Course 400/-)

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
